era.title: Planetary Transformation
era.subtitle: Earth becomes a restored, managed, and consciously stewarded planet
era.description: This era shows humanity transforming Earth through climate restoration, ecological repair, circular manufacturing, autonomous infrastructure, AI-managed cities, ocean expansion, and advanced human-support systems.

seo.metaTitle: Era 4: Planetary Transformation | Future Civilization Roadmap
seo.metaDescription: Explore planetary transformation through climate-restored deserts, artificial coral reefs, global rewilding corridors, AI-designed cities, zero-waste manufacturing, and fusion-powered food systems.
